correctness.rationale: The lifted differences satisfy Y_j=b+jh+h S_j g_h and Z_j=c+jb+binom(j,2)h+h sum weighted g_h, with mean-zero compact C0 family g_h. Uniform unique ergodicity gives sup partial sums=o(n) and weighted sums=o(n^2). The radius condition prevents any integer modular winding. The second-difference of Z at 0, floor((n-1)/2), n-1 forces |h|=O(epsilon/n^2), then b=O(epsilon/n). Rescaling leads uniformly in all centers to quadratic polynomial C+tB+(A/2)t^2, where the limiting convex coefficient body has volume 544/9 by endpoint/curvature integration. Rechecked exact endpoint w-interval integral: coefficient volume 272/9, doubled for A gives 544/9. The argument, not sampled orbit checks, covers all irrational alpha and C1 psi. Structural grid bounds give exponent three.
